auditor.role: independent source, reproduction, and implementation-alignment reviewer

scope.reviewed: Frozen source feasibility inspection and its adoption recommendation

gate_decisions.basis: Auditor-owned wrapper invoked the frozen command with explicit ISO-8859-1, uv 0.8.19, Python 3.12.11, RDFLib 7.1.4, the D: cache and original project environment. Return code was 0, no timeout occurred, and the 1,740,826-byte output is byte-identical to inspection-03.json at SHA-256 b563fdfc....

The final inspector verifies every manifest pin before parsing, requires an explicit encoding and a fresh output, retains the UTF-8 and class-IRI correction history, reports rather than repairs label/hierarchy differences, and stays within structural feasibility scope. The RDFLib invalid-date warning remains visible.
limitations: The field hyphen_leaf_count is a structural leaf count, not the primary paper’s hierarchy-level terminology; NN-dd codes are second-level hyphen classes.
The field cross_references.dangling means outside the selected code-concept set, not unresolved resource.

gate_decisions.basis: All seven snapshots match the source manifest. Primary source/site locators support the official CSV role, suggestion status, hierarchy/code forms, qualified-reference reification and CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 source terms. Direct record checks confirm the eight dual parents, the collection target, actual lowercase data class, separate-vocabulary IRI mismatch and invalid date lexical form.
limitations: License identity and relevant source terms were verified; this is not legal advice or a certification of a downstream use.
The source paper’s model and examples do not override differing exact IRIs or dual-parent triples in the pinned dataset.

gate_decisions.basis: The final code was read in full. A separately written checker passed 23 checks and exactly matched the author output’s CSV summary, code sets, all 120 label-difference rows, all 6603 hierarchy rows, eight disagreement rows, all 3083 selected direct triples and all 415 reification rows. It additionally verified one-to-one seeFor pointers and RDF scope term forms.
limitations: inspection-03 stringifies scopes and therefore does not itself retain datatype/language; the importer must read the pinned RDF or otherwise preserve this information.
The inspector does not validate every RDF triple and does not adjudicate semantic correctness of labels or parents.

csv.strict_utf8: fails at byte offset 5168 on f6

labels.interpretation: A string mismatch is not automatically a semantic error. Reviewed probes show a mix of surface rewording, moved qualification and potentially scope-changing text.

hierarchy.actual_source_condition: Each has both 32-XX and 33-XX as recorded parents; all parent URIs resolve to selected concepts.
hierarchy.adjudication: Retain and flag; notation expectation alone does not authorize deleting a parent or declaring a source error.

outside_concept_target.meaning_of_author_dangling: target is outside the selected concept set only

adoption_decision.statement: Use the pinned official CSV as the candidate classification backbone. Treat the pinned Turtle as a separately attributed suggestion supplying source assertions and qualified navigation records. Do not import it wholesale as an official ontology or as a proved mathematical graph.

requirements.text: Pin and verify all source bytes and the Git revision; fail closed on hash mismatch. Do not fetch mutable latest inputs during an import.
Require the CSV encoding explicitly as ISO-8859-1 for this snapshot, preserve raw bytes, reject replacement characters, and record that HTTP declared no charset.
Retain CSV code, text, description and physical record locator exactly. Use measured snapshot counts rather than website or paper prose totals.
Represent NN-dd as a second-level hyphen-form class even when it is structurally a leaf; store hierarchy level, notation form and has-children status separately.

If notation-derived CSV hierarchy is selected as the backbone, retain the RDF broader assertions separately. Emit all eight dual-parent disagreements as source conflicts without silent deletion, addition or error adjudication.

Retain both raw labels for all 120 differences with exact-match status and source locator. Choose any display-label precedence explicitly; do not label the entire set erroneous without semantic review.

Emit all 3083 selected relations with raw source URI, predicate IRI, target URI, target kind, source revision and locator. Treat them as MSC navigation assertions, not equivalence, implication or proof.

For each of the 415 conditional relations, preserve the reification URI, exact rdf:subject/predicate/object, incoming seeFor pointer, scope lexical value, datatype/language and the direct seeConditionally edge. Reject incomplete, duplicate or mismatched linkage records.
Resolve GeneralReferenceWorksCollection as target_kind=collection with its own metadata. Do not call it dangling/unresolved or expand its 62 members into inferred direct edges.

Preserve the data file’s actual HTTP/lowercase IRIs and the separate vocabulary file’s HTTPS/path/uppercase IRIs. Do not assert identity from spelling similarity; any application enum mapping must retain the raw IRI and be explicitly local.
Retain the lexical placeholder 2021-03-xx and validation warning or quarantine that metadata field; do not synthesize a valid source date.

Carry source-specific attribution, source and license URLs, CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 identity and modification status. Keep official MR/zbMATH classification attribution, suggested-SKOS provenance and project code licensing distinct; assess downstream license compatibility before redistribution.
Reject duplicate/invalid codes and unresolved hierarchy identifiers; produce deterministic output and a complete source-to-output accounting ledger before product promotion.
Do not automatically map Atlas concepts to MSC codes or claim complete mathematical coverage, source correctness, practical impact, performance or novelty.

limitations: This gate approves the source-feasibility conclusion only. It does not approve the separately authored importer or any product use.
No full source snapshot or paper text is included in the publication subset.
No claim is made that any of the 120 label differences or eight parent differences is a source error without further adjudication.
